title: Hörmander’s method for the characteristic Cauchy problem and conformal scattering for a non linear wave equation
author: Jérémie Joudioux
locator: Appendix A, pp.20–21, Theorem A.1; m=1 and j=0
text: Let X and Y be Hilbert spaces, with X continuously and densely embedded in Y. For a finite interval [a,b], if u belongs to L2([a,b];X) and its distributional time derivative belongs to L2([a,b];Y), then u has a bounded continuous representative taking values in the interpolation space [X,Y]_(1/2).
qualifications: Specialization of independently printed m-th derivative trace theorem to m=1,j=0.
The embedding must be dense and continuous; an arbitrary continuous linear map is insufficient.
No graph-norm formula is invented or attributed to this theorem; continuous trace-space membership is the selected target.
This research paper reproduces classical Lions–Magenes, citing LM72 Chapter1 Theorems2.3,3.1; the original 1972 book was not downloaded.
